2.name: The Cruel Queen and the Fiance
2.overview: The queen announces Pride's engagement on her 16th birthday. It may seem like the perfect match, but Pride knows it's anything but a fairy tale.

2.name: The Cruel Queen Speaks
2.overview: Pride knows what lies in store for Leon, and she is determined to safeguard her fiance's happiness. However, Pride's friends worry that she isn't safeguarding her own.

2.name: The Cruel Queen and the Truth
2.overview: Pride will not suffer a conspiracy aimed at Prince Leon.

2.name: The Cruel Queen Makes a Declaration
2.overview: With Leon and the Anemone Kingdom destined to fall into ruin, Pride confronts the conspirators directly.

2.name: The Cruel Queen Takes Notice, and is Noticed
2.overview: With the engagement behind her, Pride faces the future with what her evil counterpart never had: people who care for her.

2.name: The Audacious Queen and Alcohol
2.overview: Roles and priorities may change, but that doesn't mean bonds disappear.

2.name: The Cruel Queen and Alliance Negotiations
2.overview: According to the game, Prince Cedric is meant to be Tiara's future fiancé. But the script changes when he sets his eyes on Pride instead.

2.name: The Diabolical Princess and the Fool
2.overview: Cedric doesn't understand how close he is to causing an international incident. Pride may not like him, but she can't allow such a mistake to happen.

2.name: The Cruel Princess and the Request
2.overview: The Kingdom of Copelandii will invade sooner than expected.

2.name: The Cruel Princess and the Second-born Prince
2.overview: Cedric is wracked with guilt over the crisis facing his country, but Pride assures him that the future isn't set in stone.

2.name: The Blasphemous Princess Prepares Herself
2.overview: When tensions between allied kingdoms rise, Pride must cross a closed border to discover the reason why.

2.name: The Blasphemous Princess Takes a Stand
2.overview: Three nations unite after Pride gambles with her life and vows to protect her allies.

originalTitle: 悲劇の元凶となる最強外道ラスボス女王は民の為に尽くします。
overview: Pride Royal Ivy is only eight years old when she realizes that she's been reincarnated, destined to become the future wicked queen and final boss of an otome game. She's got it all in this new life: razor-sharp wit, boss-tier powers, and influence over the kingdom as crown princess. Determined to sow despair and destruction across the land, she... Wait, what kind of a rotten future is that?! Princess Pride decides to drop the maniacal villainess plan and protect the male love interests instead, cheating her way to saving everyone she can! Will this final boss end up earning the adoration of her kingdom?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
Eight-year-old Pride Royal Ivy suddenly recalls her former life as a fan of the otome game Our Ray of Light. While on her way to replay it, she tragically died, reincarnating as the game's final boss and firstborn princess of Freesia. Her knowledge of the game's events leads everyone to believe she has the power of precognition. But unlike the game's original princess, this new Pride does not wish to torment those around her, such as her younger sister and adopted brother.

Haunted by nightmares of her other self's atrocities, Pride resolves to protect her family and country while progressing the story. As the world around her changes, she prepares for the day she will have to die at the hands of the game's main characters. Nevertheless, before that happens, Pride will either transform her kingdom for the better or fall under the weight of her possible crimes.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As Pride Royal Ivy's actions continue to alter the future, the world drifts further from the original game's story. While striving to protect those around her, she becomes entangled in international conflicts, political conspiracies, and looming threats that challenge everything she thought she knew about fate. With new allies, uncertain enemies, and a kingdom on the brink of war, Pride must face the consequences of changing destiny itself.

title: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
